counters.vs_baba: CAUTION: her Threadsap steals Spirit Power — your entire damage stat. This is your worst matchup on this archetype; consider the Vitality build instead, or rush Dispel Magic (3200 Vitality) to cleanse.

counters.vs_violet: Dispel Magic (3200 Vitality) cleanses Still Life and ink slows. Echo Shard lets you double-cast Splatter the instant her wall drops — she can't answer two volleys back to back.

spirit.kit_synergy: Every Viscous ability scales with Spirit Power — Splatter poke, Cube heal, Puddle Punch, Goo Ball — so Boundless Spirit is a whole-kit multiplier. Imbue Mystic Reverb / Echo Shard into Splatter for the live build's double-cast goo (91.85% pick rate on Mystic Burst), and Transcendent Cooldown keeps Splatter, Cube, and Goo Ball permanently cycling. Arcane Surge rewards the dash-jump into Splatter or Goo Ball the current build is built around.
